purpose: Compare frozen IRIS NEW-crossing probabilities with NOAA/SWPC day-1 operational S1 proton-event probabilities on identical eligible daily issue dates.
target_semantics: Eligible only when >=10 pfu is not already active at 00:00 UTC; positive only if a new operational >=10 MeV, >=10 pfu event starts in the next 24 hours.

swpc_product.name: Joint USAF/NOAA Report of Solar and Geophysical Activity (RSGA/SGARF)
swpc_product.issue_time: 22:00 UTC nominal on prior calendar day
swpc_product.validity_alignment: RSGA is valid from 00:00 UTC of the following day; use only the first PROTON probability in Section III for that following day.
swpc_product.physical_event: GOES >=10 MeV integral proton flux exceeding 10 pfu (S1 threshold)
swpc_product.parser_rule: Case-insensitive line beginning PROTON followed by three slash-separated integer percentages; day-1 is first integer.
swpc_product.missing_file_policy: ABSTAIN_NO_SWPC_FORECAST; never impute an operational forecast.

roles.threshold: Use existing IRIS ALL_HISTORY threshold role only for any data-derived decision threshold.
roles.score: 2014-2023 development score block; already inspected in prior diagnostics.
roles.monitor: 2023-2025 development monitor; already inspected in prior diagnostics.

swpc_decision_policies.FIXED_50_PERCENT: Historical published contingency convention; threshold=0.50 fixed before archive inspection.
swpc_decision_policies.MAX_TSS: Choose on common threshold-role dates only; lowest-probability tie break.
swpc_decision_policies.POD80_MIN_FAR: Choose on common threshold-role dates only; minimum FAR among thresholds achieving POD>=0.80.

iris_decision_policies.POD80_MIN_FAR: Existing IRIS threshold-role minimum-FAR at POD>=0.80 selection.

paired_bootstrap.unit: complete SEP episode / predeclared quiet block

coverage_rule: Report archive coverage separately for threshold, score, and monitor. Never remove an IRIS miss/false alarm because SWPC is unavailable; paired metrics are explicitly common-row metrics and unpaired IRIS full-coverage metrics remain separately reported.
claim_rule: This is a retrospective same-date comparison to an archived operational forecast on development periods already used during IRIS development. It is stronger external evidence but not a fresh final superiority test. No claim that IRIS beats NOAA operational forecasting unless exact alignment, coverage, parser audit, and uncertainty are reported; no operational-readiness claim.
